snapshot.name: ak:handoff
snapshot.description: Create a portable, redacted Markdown continuation contract that a fresh coding agent can consume to resume in-progress work safely, and optionally dispatch it to a selected coding runtime with --dispatch. Use when switching sessions, models, or runtimes, or when preserving decisions, verification state, and blockers.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke to capture a session's continuation contract for a successor agent, or with --dispatch --agent <id> to capture it and hand the work to a selected coding runtime through orchestrate. For a human-facing status report derived from branches, worktrees, plans, and repository history, use ak-watzup instead.
